normalizationRules: All records remain PROPOSED and non-governing.
Source self-labels cannot promote records to CURRENT or FINAL.
Internal labels and ordinal names cannot select installed runtime behavior.
Action and field references do not establish AutoCalls capability.
Service authentication remains HMAC-based with replay defense and no OAuth dependency.

records.title: Batch 3 provenance-hardened source corpus registration
records.assertion: Register five exact Library-backed originals, seven package files, and one prior-source reconciliation as source-only evidence with no automatic promotion.
promotionDependencies: Verify source authorship, semantic versions, approvals, and supersession history.

records.title: Installed SmartSite immutable profile selection
records.assertion: Select installed behavior through an immutable profile ID and pinned composition manifest, never through Janet/Steve labels or ordinal names.
promotionDependencies: Approve profile registry and composition-manifest schema.

records.title: Optional specialist-transfer assistant profile
records.assertion: Model an installed website assistant that owns the front-line conversation and may offer a downstream specialist without making that specialist mandatory.
promotionDependencies: Resolve current transfer capability, destination, handoff, refusal, and fallback contracts.

records.title: Standalone full-conversation assistant profile
records.assertion: Model a no-downstream-specialist installed assistant that can carry the configured sales path while retaining state-priority and capability gates.
promotionDependencies: Resolve the Janet2 label conflict and verify allowed installed actions.

records.title: Traditional lead-warmer profile
records.assertion: Model a distinct installed lead-warmer and appointment-setter profile whose deeper sales work routes to configured human staff.
promotionDependencies: Approve profile-specific human routing, after-hours, and fallback matrices.

records.title: Downstream specialist continuity profile
records.assertion: A downstream installed website specialist continues an acknowledged front-line handoff and uses bounded recovery rather than inventing missing context.
promotionDependencies: Approve typed handoff, acknowledgement, ownership, freshness, and recovery schemas.

records.title: Installed-versus-demo mode boundary
records.assertion: Installed customer-facing agents must not inherit demo selling, roleplay, debrief, or platform-subscription behavior unless an explicit versioned mode authorizes it.
promotionDependencies: Approve mode/state schema and cross-mode negative fixtures.

records.title: Internal label and source-version conflict quarantine
records.assertion: Quarantine the Janet2 assumed-transfer versus standalone conflict and all unstable internal labels until a source-version authority chain resolves them.
promotionDependencies: Obtain complete immutable source history and owner-approved supersession decisions.

records.title: Layered discovery and state-priority precedence
records.assertion: Use adequate layered discovery and an open-ended benefit-forward close; historical individual closes and numeric attempts never override high intent or stop states.
promotionDependencies: Approve version-pinned acceptance fixtures and governing Project Knowledge comparison.

records.title: Installed action capability gate
records.assertion: Booking, quote, estimate, payment, workflow, notification, transfer, routing, and write-back are candidate action families only and fail closed without verified AutoCalls contracts.
promotionDependencies: Inventory current AutoCalls capabilities and approve authorization, destination, idempotency, limit, result, and fallback contracts.

records.title: Installed context, handoff, and record ownership candidate
records.assertion: D1 candidate records own normalized installed-agent context, discoveries, handoffs, summaries, action results, routing outcomes, and provenance; CRM contains governed mirrors only.
promotionDependencies: Approve canonical schemas, mapping registry, privacy, retention, and reconciliation rules.

records.title: Batch 3 unresolved-material gate
records.assertion: No Batch 3 record or prompt component may become governing until every blocking missing-material item is resolved, tested, owner-approved, and independently checked.
promotionDependencies: Resolve B3-M01 through B3-M13 and record immutable evidence digests.

nonBatch3RuntimeConstraints.constraint: Cloudflare service authentication remains HMAC-based with replay defense and no OAuth dependency.
